description: Set TestFlight test information: beta app info (feedback email, description, marketing URL, privacy policy URL), the build's What to Test, and the Beta App Review contact. Every value is an input, none is invented. Creates or updates per locale. Without confirm:true it only previews. Pro feature.

confirm.description: Required to write. Without it the tool only previews.

description.description: Beta app description shown in TestFlight

locale.description: Locale such as en-US. Omit to use the app's primary locale.

marketing_url.description: https URL with information about the app

privacy_policy_url.description: https URL of the privacy policy

review_contact_first_name.description: Beta App Review contact first name

review_contact_last_name.description: Beta App Review contact last name

review_contact_phone.description: Beta App Review contact phone, with country code

whats_new.description: What to Test for one build. Needs build_id.

name: set_beta_test_info
title: Set TestFlight test information
